page.overview:
Who is Fat Beirut Agent?

Fat Beirut Agent is a minor character in the 1974 film The Man With The Golden Gun. He was played by George Silver.

The three thugs, the Fat Beirut Agent and his two henchmen Ahmed and Rahman, observe Bond who is viewing a dancer, Saida, in a bar. They tail Bond who is on his to way to the the dancer's dressing room, on his way to retrieve a golden bullet which killed 002 that was seen on the dancer. With the three thugs finding Bond in the dressing room, a fight begins, with the thugs eventually managing to strike Bond from behind causing him to swallow the bullet. After the brutal brawl ends, the three thugs are rendered unconscious by Bond.
